|quest_reward3_type = vendor |quest_reward3_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Frost Shield''' is a [[spell]] that creates a [[chilling area]] around the caster for a [[duration]]. The area drains your [[energy shield]] when initially cast, and uses the absorbed energy shield to redirect a percentage of the damage the user takes to itself while the user is within it. The user also gains increased spell [[critical strike]] chance while within the field. ==Skill functions and interactions== [[Chilling Area]]: Enemies that are inside the chilling area become chilled by the player. Modifiers to chill and cold/non-damaging ailments apply, including from [[support gem]]s. It can apply ''chilled by you'' stats, enable ''if you have chilled recently'' stats, and cannot chill when the player or skill cannot chill. [[Energy Shield]] Recharge: Recharge is disabled while the effect is draining energy shield. Despite not being [[damage]], the drain also interrupts ES recharge, which {{psl|id=wicked_ward_keystone2342}} may prevent.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3533110 ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Frost Shield
